tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: a clean, solid deep-ink ground (cream in Day party) that lets full-value color blocks pop, exactly as on the cover. Aura glows are optional.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Solid raised surfaces where blur is unavailable or too costly (long lists, Android fallbacks).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted panel fill. Always use with backdrop-filter blur(var(--blur-glass)) and a line border.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed glass, sheets and modals that sit above other glass.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders on glass, dividers, input outlines at rest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, bg-raised and glass in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, captions, hints) on bg and glass; 4.5:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Hero accent: the primary action, the brand moment. Fill only; text on it is on-bright.

tokens.name: pop-ink
tokens.usage: Pink when it has to be text or a link on bg / glass (pop itself is too light for text on Day party).

tokens.name: zap
tokens.usage: Electric lime. 'Going' state, success, secondary celebratory actions. Fill only, with on-bright text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Warm yellow. 'Maybe' state, highlights, stickers. Fill only.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Cyan accent for color blocks, posters, avatars and stickers. Fill only.

tokens.name: grape
tokens.usage: Soft violet for color blocks, posters, avatars and stickers. Fill only; never blended with sky in a gradient.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text, icons and sticker outlines on any neon fill (pop, zap, sun, sky, grape). Never white on neon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirmations only. Text-safe on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset.

tokens.name: aura-1
tokens.usage: Optional faint pink glow (opt in with ag-root--aura) behind glass-heavy screens; also the pink focus halo on inputs. Never strong enough to tint the color blocks.

tokens.name: aura-2
tokens.usage: Optional faint warm glow paired with aura-1 (opt in with ag-root--aura).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Event titles on posters and hero moments. One per screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Bring snacks, bring friends, bring the vibes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Saturday at 8pm · The roof at Mika's

styles.name: flourish
styles.usage: One or two words of personality inside a display line. Never a full sentence.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge, avatar overlap offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inline elements.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, RSVP options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, field padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), screen side margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room, top of screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, inputs inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Event posters, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, RSVP options, stickers, avatars. Default for anything tappable.

tokens.name: glow-pop
tokens.usage: Under the primary pop button only.

tokens.name: glow-zap
tokens.usage: Under a selected 'Going' RSVP and zap buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards and event posters floating over the aura.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on glass panels, buttons and nav bars.

tokens.name: blur-heavy
tokens.usage: Full-screen modal backdrops and blurred poster backgrounds.
